ModMetaData.name: Numbers Performance Fix
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Unofficial performance fix for Numbers. Reduces the lag while a Numbers tab is open.
Numbers redraws its window several times per frame, and every time it: - builds and sorts every drop-down menu at the top (Stats, Health, Abilities, Other...), even though they are only needed when a button is clicked; - counts every pawn and corpse on the map for the "Count" label; - recalculates every text cell from scratch (stat values are requested without any cache), so expensive stats such as melee DPS cost a lot every frame; - builds the full tooltip text of every skill and disease cell, even when the mouse is not over it. Sorting by a stat column also recalculated the stat for both pawns on every comparison.
Fix: - Menus are built only when you click a button. The menus you get are the same. - The count is refreshed twice per second. - Text and icon cells (stats, records, capacities, jobs, health...) are cached for about half a second (not recalculated at all while paused), including columns from other mods and need-bar arrows. Outdated cells keep their last value and are recalculated oldest first, averaging at most about 1 ms per frame, so expensive columns such as melee DPS no longer cause stutter (they may lag a few seconds behind while the game runs). A click or key press refreshes all cells. - Sorting by a stat column calculates each pawn's value once per sort. The order is the same. - Skill, disease, gear and inventory tooltips are built only for the cell under the mouse.
Interactive columns (inventory, equipment, drop buttons) still update instantly. With Development mode on, the most expensive Numbers columns are logged every 10 seconds.
Notes: - Requires Numbers. Load after Numbers. - Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.
